author: Loyal customer until
title: Years of ignoring users abroad has forced us to switch to Khalti
review_text: eSewa remains the biggest wallet in Nepal, yet it still completely neglects the diaspora and international users. Looking through reviews over the years, the #1 complaint has always been the rigid SMS-only OTP system.  Thousands of us living abroad rely on digital wallets to pay electricity, internet, and household bills for our aging parents back home. Without access to a Nepali SIM, eSewa becomes totally useless overseas.  Khalti solved this instantly with their Khalti Roaming (Email OTP) feature, which is why so many of us have had to switch. Until eSewa introduces in-app email OTP/roaming and fixes international KYC verification, you will continue losing loyal users to competitors.
